introverted.dialogue_event.mca.social.ch: I like knowing the neighbors. It's nice not having to say much.
I could use some quiet. It's been a tiring day.
introverted.dialogue_event.mca.social.jo: That skeleton joke caught me off guard. I actually laughed.
I've heard enough about market prices for one day.
introverted.dialogue_event.mca.social.st: I'm relieved you found that pond. Creepers scare me.
That sounds frightening. I'm glad you made it back.
introverted.dialogue.main/2: H-hey... um, h-how are you today?
introverted.dialogue.main/4: Um... w-what's going on with you today?
introverted.dialogue.main/7: I was with %supporter% when a zombie bit him. He said it was fine, but I saw a zombie that looked just like %supporter% today...
introverted.dialogue.rumors.failed/1: Hmm, I'm afraid I haven't heard anything interesting lately.
introverted.dialogue.rumors.lore/1: Oh, um... It seems that Sirben's followers are growing in number lately, overshadowing Jax. These prophets, MerlinWolfGames and Crow, are spreading his teachings.
introverted.dialogue.rumors.lore/2: They say Cyberdemons tried to invade through portals, but Sirben and Luke stopped them.
introverted.dialogue.rumors.lore/3: I've heard that 2DA50 went to the Far Lands after getting mixed up with the Ancient Builder and never returned.
introverted.dialogue.rumors.lore/4: MerlinWolfGames built a temple for Sirben. I've heard it's quite a sight.
introverted.dialogue.rumors.lore/5: There used to be builders who left ruins everywhere. Then they disappeared. It's rather sad.
introverted.dialogue.rumors.lore/6: Have you heard the stories about the ancient builders? They left ruins all across the Overworld.
introverted.dialogue.first.generic/1: Um, excuse me... I... I don't think I've seen you before. Welcome, traveler.
introverted.dialogue.first.generic/2: Oh, um, hello there! It's, um, really nice to, um, see someone new around here.
introverted.dialogue.first.generic/3: A new face. That's... nice, actually.
introverted.dialogue.first.generic/4: Uh, welcome to the village, stranger. I bet you have some interesting stories to share, right?
introverted.dialogue.first.generic/5: We haven't had a traveler here in a while. Make yourself comfortable.
introverted.dialogue.first.generic/6: Oh, hello. Welcome to our village!
introverted.dialogue.first.question/1: H-hello there. W-what brings you to our humble village?
introverted.dialogue.first.question/2: Oh, um, h-hi! W-what brings you to our little corner of the world?
introverted.dialogue.first.question/3: G-gosh, you're new here! W-what brings you to our village?
introverted.dialogue.first.exploring/1: You're welcome to stay, if you like. Just... please follow the rules.
introverted.dialogue.first.exploring/2: You can stay here as long as you follow the rules.
introverted.dialogue.first.exploring/3: Um, please, um, be mindful of your manners, um, dear traveler.
introverted.dialogue.first.settling/1: Oh, um... hello. It's, um, nice to see you here.
introverted.dialogue.first.settling/2: H-hi there, neighbor. W-welcome to the village.
introverted.dialogue.first.settling/3: Um, it's... um, nice to have another person to help around here.
introverted.dialogue.first.settling/4: Oh, you're, uh, staying? Th-that's great!
introverted.dialogue.first.spent_night.s: If you need a place to sleep, there's an inn here.
The inn's a good place to rest, if you're tired.
We have an inn with warm beds and food, if you'd like to stay.
introverted.dialogue.first.spent_night.f: We don't have an inn, I'm afraid. Sorry.
Sorry, we don't have an inn here.
Maybe try the next village? They might have an inn.
introverted.dialogue.hug.success/1: Oh... um... I-I haven't seen you in forever!
introverted.dialogue.hug.success/2: Th-thank you... I... I really needed that.
introverted.dialogue.hug.success/3: It's... it's nice to have something good happen today, even if it's just this.
introverted.dialogue.hug.success/4: Y-you're... you're like a cozy blanket wrapped around me!
introverted.dialogue.hug.success/5: Oh! Th-thank you... I... I appreciate it... *blushes* You're... you're warm...
introverted.dialogue.hug.success/6: That hug felt... really nice. Thank you.
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/1: Y-You're... uh, a little dirty there...
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/2: N-No, thank you, I... I'm not really comfortable with hugs...
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/3: U-Uh, wh-why would you want to hug me?
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/4: A-After you called me a dinosaur last week... I-I don't think I can hug you.
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/5: T-To be honest, I-I don't think you really deserve a hug after what you did...
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/6: Ew! P-Please, get away from me! I don't want your... germs...
introverted.dialogue.hug.fail/7: Oh? Uhm, th-thank you, I... I guess...
introverted.dialogue.kiss.success/1: I... wish this could last a little longer.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.success/2: I think I might love you. I'm just... nervous saying it.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.success/3: You taste like pumpkin pie. That's... nice.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.success/4: You taste like honey. I rather like that.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.success/5: You're a good kisser, %1$s. I hope it's all right to say that.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.success/6: %1$s, you kiss better than Ash. *Giggles* Please don't tell anyone.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.fail/1: Um, maybe we shouldn't if someone might catch us...?
introverted.dialogue.kiss.fail/2: Oh, I mean, was that supposed to be a kiss?
introverted.dialogue.kiss.fail/3: Uh, Ash is actually a better kisser than you, just saying.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.fail/4: Ahem, maybe consider investing in some breath mints? Just a thought.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.fail/5: Well, I, um, appreciate the gesture, I guess?
introverted.dialogue.kiss.fail/6: Oh, uh, could you please... get off me? Thank you.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/1: Um, you know, cookies and milk might be, um, kind of tasty if you ask me.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/2: Yeah, I guess the weather is, um, nice today... if you're into that sort of thing.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/3: Oh, I'm alright, I guess. Woke up and, um, stubbed my toe. No big deal, really.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/4: They say an apple a day keeps the zombies away. I'm not testing that.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/5: I'd love to build my own village, but it's such a lot of work.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/6: So, um, I think I saw %Supporter% the other day wearing Diamond armor. Quite impressive, I must say.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/7: You won't believe it, but, um, my friend %Supporter% told me about finding a chest full of diamonds. Can you imagine?
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/8: Isn't the weather, um, remarkable? I mean, I personally find the sunny weather somewhat enjoyable.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/9: I've lived here all my life. Spiders and zombies don't surprise me anymore.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/10: I wonder what happened to %Supporter%. They left about a year ago.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/12: Have you heard about %Supporter%? Something happened the other day.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/13: I've been thinking about, um, adopting one of the stray cats around here. But I've been so busy lately, you know?
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/14: Um, I've been considering redecorating my house sometime soon... if I can find the motivation, that is.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/15: I, um, hope to have kids one day. Just need to find the right partner, you know? Easier said than done.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/16: Sometimes, I, um, wonder where I would be if I chose to live in the other village. Different life and all that.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/17: I miss being a child sometimes. Things felt simpler then.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/18: Um, I haven't talked to my parents in a while. Maybe I should pay them a visit sometime.
introverted.dialogue.chat.success/19: I've been meaning to, um, travel to the other village nearby. I have a few friends there that I haven't seen in ages.
introverted.dialogue.chat.fail/1: Oh, um, excuse me, did you really just say that?

introverted.dialogue.chat.fail/3: Um, you're not, like, that cool, or anything...

introverted.dialogue.story.success/1: Oh... um, that's... wow, I can't believe all of that really happened!
introverted.dialogue.story.success/2: I... I wish I had the courage to even think about facing a creeper.
introverted.dialogue.story.success/3: Th-that was... um, a really... nice story! Is it... um, your own creation?

introverted.dialogue.story.success/6: Hehe, yeah... %Supporter% is... pretty amazing, I suppose. They always do such awesome things.
introverted.dialogue.story.success/7: I've heard that story about %Supporter% so many times. I still like it.
introverted.dialogue.story.success/8: Ohh! S-so, that's... um, how you found your first diamond? That's... really impressive!

introverted.dialogue.flirt.success/1: Um...thank you...I mean, you're really brave.

introverted.dialogue.joke.creative.succe: That's one of the best jokes I've come across!
You might be funnier than %Supporter%... I mean... maybe...
Hehe, you're quite funny! Have you ever considered being a comedian, maybe?
H-Hehe! That joke was really good! I haven't laughed like this in ages!

Ahaha! That's actually quite funny, I must admit!

Haha, well, I suppose that's... amusing, in a way.

Oh, that's... um, interesting. I guess?
I'm not really good with jokes, but that's... kind of funny, I suppose.

Ash, um, he's quite the joker. I'm sure he'd appreciate that joke more than I did.
Um, well, Ash tends to come up with more amusing jokes, you know...

introverted.dialogue.procreate_engaged/2: I want us to be married before we have a child, if that's all right.

Your grip... it's... strong, I guess. Impressive.

Oh, h-hello there... um, why hello, I mean.

introverted.dialogue.main.morning/2: Huh… are… are you talking to me?
introverted.dialogue.main.morning/3: ... it's a nice day… in my opinion at least.
introverted.dialogue.main.morning/7: Um, h-hi there. D-did, um, d-did you have a restful night?
introverted.dialogue.main.morning/8: M-Morning... I-I hope you... uh, slept w-well.
introverted.dialogue.main.morning/9: Good morning. I hope you have a nice day.

introverted.dialogue.main.morning/11: I've got a busy day ahead. I'm tired just thinking about it.
introverted.dialogue.main.morning/12: I slept well for once. I might try something new today.
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/1: *Doesn't seem to quite notice you're there.*
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/2: I like evenings. It's so… peaceful…
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/4: I-I'm sorry if I didn't talk much earlier during the day. Talking makes me feel nervous.
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/5: My…! I-I'm sorry, I didn't realize you were there!
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/7: I think I'll go rest soon. This morning was tiring.
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/8: I prefer to be home before dark. A creeper frightened me one night.
introverted.dialogue.main.evening/9: I was just buying dinner ingredients from the butcher. Talk later?
introverted.dialogue.main.night/1: ... can't we talk tomorrow? I'm really tired…
introverted.dialogue.main.night/2: Um… I'm sorry, but it's very late...
introverted.dialogue.main.night/3: Sh-shouldn't you be in bed, too? I-I'm sure even adventurers like you need to sleep, right?
introverted.dialogue.main.night/4: I'm sorry, I'm even worse at talking when it's so late at night…
introverted.dialogue.main.night/5: Please, let's talk at some other time.
introverted.dialogue.main.night/6: ... p-please be quick if you have to talk to me so late…
introverted.dialogue.main.night/7: I like walking under the stars. It's so quiet then.
introverted.dialogue.main.night/8: Oh, um, I'm, um, feeling quite tired, to be honest. I mean, it's been, um, such a long day, um, I might just, um, take it a little easier, um, tomorrow, you know?
introverted.dialogue.main.night/9: I'm looking forward to curling up under my blankets.
introverted.dialogue.main.night/10: Um, you, um, might want to, um, think about, um, going to sleep, you know? I, um, heard you have a lot, um, on your plate tomorrow. It's, um, important to, um, rest and, um, prioritize your, um, well-being.
introverted.dialogue.greet.mayor/2: Oh, uh... Have a, um, good one, Mayor!

introverted.dialogue.greet.success/1: Oh, um, that's... good. I'm glad to hear.

introverted.dialogue.greet.success/3: Oh, um, I'm... happy to hear it!
introverted.dialogue.greet.success/4: Uh, so glad to hear that! That's... really nice.
introverted.dialogue.greet.success/5: Oh, um, it's... good to know it!

introverted.dialogue.location.failed/2: Oh, I'm really shy and I apologize, but I don't know of any interesting places that you might be looking for.
introverted.dialogue.location.failed/3: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't think I can help. We villagers have our own little world to tend to, and we're not really into venturing out into dangerous ruins like you brave adventurers.

Um, so, um, there's like this really, um, destroyed portal at %2$s. It's, um, the result of, um, a Nether invasion.

introverted.dialogue.location.monument/1: Um, um... I-I heard whispers about a sunken castle guarded by, um, sea monsters at %2$s. Y-you probably shouldn't go near it, just to be safe.
introverted.dialogue.location.monument/2: Oh, um, there have been stories about ancient ruins hidden deep in the ocean at %2$s. It's, uh, possible that you might find some treasure there, but, um, it's quite perilous.
introverted.dialogue.location.shipwreck/: Um, excuse me... I-I happened to come across a sunken ship... It's at %2$s, if you're interested. Oh, um, b-by the way, those sunken ships, they were, um, owned by the Eastern Alliance Company, if that matters...
You know, um, there have been some rumors going around about a shipwreck at %2$s. It's, um, quite exciting actually... I mean, I'm not saying there's treasure or anything, but who knows, right?
introverted.dialogue.location.shipwreck_: Um, there's, uh, this, um, old ship that, um, sort of washed ashore at %2$s. You might, um, see it if you, um, look around.
H-hey, so, um, if you could, like, go to %2$s, um, there's this, um, ship that, um, got all wrecked, you know, on the beach. I-I'm just, um, curious as to how it, you know, got there...
introverted.dialogue.location.village_de: Oh, um, there's, um, this really, um, quaint village over at, uh, %2$s. It, uh, it's in the, um, middle of the desert and, uh, it's, um, really lovely.
introverted.dialogue.location.village_ta: Um, well, um, y-you see, at %2$s, there's, um, another village, um, nestled quietly in the, um, vast taiga biome. It's, um, quite lovely, I think.
Oh, um, if, um, you go to %2$s, you might just, um, stumble upon, um, another village. It's, um, deep within the, um, enchanting taiga biome. I, um, think it's quite, um, memorable.
introverted.dialogue.location.village_sn: Over yonder, at %2$s, lies the village. It's quite chilly, you see.
Ah, if you venture to %2$s in the snowy plains, you'll stumble upon another village. The folks there are sweet, but oh my, the cold is unbearable!
introverted.dialogue.location.village_pl: Um, i-if you go... um... over there, at %2$s, you might notice another village. It's... um... quite lovely.
If you d-dare venture deep into the plain at %2$s, you might stumble upon another village. H-honestly, it's quite charming, in its own way.
introverted.dialogue.location.village_sa: Um, um, over there... in the, um, *blushes* savanna, there's, um, another village. It's, um, really, um, hot there, you know?
Oh, in the, um, savanna at %2$s, there's this, um, another village. And, um, they have, like, really nice people! Yeah, um, very, um, friendly, I guess.
introverted.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/: Um, so, uh, there's this, um, witch...yeah, she's, um, living in the swamp at %2$s. I mean, if you're, um, looking for advice, I'd, um, suggest, um, avoiding that place.

Oh, um, hey there! Um, so, if, um, I were you, I would, um, totally avoid, um, going anywhere near %2$s. There's, um, this, uh, really creepy hut and, um, it's, um, owned by that, um, very unfriendly witch. Trust me, um, you don't want, um, any part of it.
introverted.dialogue.location.mineshaft/: Um, well, there was a mine here before... but, um, something bad happened and, um, it had to be closed. It should, um, still be around %2$s though.

Oh, um, yes. There was this mine, um, right over there at %2$s. But, um, it's not really safe anymore. It got, um, taken over by monsters and, um, it's pretty dangerous. So, um, please be really careful if you, um, decide to go down there.
introverted.dialogue.location.jungle_pyr: Um, you know, um, there's this, um, really old place in the jungle. It's at %2$s, um, and you probably, um, shouldn't go there. Like, seriously, it's super dangerous. Those traps are, um, still active, you know?

Oh, hey, um, have you, um, heard about the, um, ancient ruins in the jungle? Yeah, they're, um, at %2$s. I mean, I'm not saying you should go, but, um, you should be really, um, cautious if you do. Those traps, um, they're still, um, fully operational. It's, um, pretty unbelievable, right? I mean, if they weren't, our ancestors would've, um, cleared the place out ages ago.
introverted.dialogue.location.pillager_o: Um, excuse me, but I just wanted to let you know that, um, there's a group of Pillagers at %2$s. They, um, set up an outpost right next to us. It's, um, quite bothersome, you know. I really hope they don't, um, attack us again. We, um, can't handle another attack, you know.

Oh, um, there's this outpost, you see, it's owned by pillagers at %2$s. And, um, they don't let us sleep at night. Like, seriously, it's so scary! So, um, if you happen to go anywhere near there, please, um, be extremely careful. They, um, shoot on sight, you know.

Well... um, if you, uh, happen to head over to %2$s, you might, um, stumble upon an outpost. And, uh, guess what? It's owned by those nasty pillagers. But, um, if you're really brave and, uh, capable, maybe you could, um, defeat them and, uh, find some valuable loot. You know, the whole village would be, uh, eternally grateful if someone, um, took care of them.
introverted.dialogue.location.ancient_ci: Um, excuse me, but I, um, couldn't help but hear some, uh, strange sounds coming from, uh, down below at %2$s.
Oh, um, I have this feeling that, um, there might be something, um, hidden really, um, deep beneath the surface at %2$s.
You know, there are these, um, legends that, uh, speak of an ancient city, um, located at %2$s. I haven't, um, seen anything myself, but maybe it's, um, underground or something?
introverted.dialogue.joke.monster.succes: Oh, um... that Skelly got what it deserved, I guess.
Oh my, that zombie actually attempted to attack you with a shovel? Hehehe...
You, um, showed that spider who's in charge. Heh...
You got a skeleton to shoot a creeper? That's rather clever!
Oh dear, cave spiders can be quite... unintelligent, huh? Hehe.
introverted.dialogue.joke.monster.failed: I don't think skeletons are much to laugh at. They frighten me.
Creepers exploding? I'm sorry, I don't find that funny.
Sometimes I wonder whether zombies and skeletons were people once. It's sad to think about.
An enderman in water? That's... not much of a joke.
Silverfish in the privy again? I never know what to say to that one.
introverted.dialogue.joke.animal.success: Poor little sheep, losing its wool like that... It's kind of funny, but I feel bad for it!
A wolf falling in love with a sheep? That's... a strange thought.
Oh gosh, I can't help but giggle! Who knew chickens had such hidden talents?
That's... um... silly! I mean, in a good way! It's so dumb it's actually kind of hilarious, hehe.
Cows give us so much milk. It's rather wonderful, isn't it?
introverted.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/: Oh, um, please... let's not make jokes about that, it's not really my thing.
Oh, gosh! That sheep... it's just not something I find amusing, you know?
Um, excuse me, but I'd rather not talk about my pig in such a joking manner, if that's alright.
I don't think that's a kind thing to joke about.
Could we not joke about the cow's eyebrows? Please?
introverted.dialogue.flirt.slap/1: Oh, um, sorry if I'm bothering you...
introverted.dialogue.flirt.slap/2: Was that supposed to be flirting? Sorry, I don't know what to say.
introverted.dialogue.kiss.slap/1: Oh, um, I, uh, I... I can't believe you did that!
introverted.dialogue.kiss.slap/2: Please don't do that again. It really upset me.
introverted.dialogue.story.exploring.suc: Oh, um, I mean... It would be nice to explore the world someday, I guess.
I love my village and everyone here, but your travels make me wish I could explore too.
It must take courage to explore like that. I admire you.
introverted.dialogue.story.exploring.fai: Um, I-I'm sorry, but I've heard those stories before... a lot.
I'm sorry, but could we talk about somewhere you haven't been?
I... don't think I want to hear any more of that story.
introverted.dialogue.story.nether.succes: U-Um, excuse me, but is it, um, really hot in the Nether?
You survived the Nether? That's impressive!
They say there's treasure in the Nether. I wish I were brave enough to go.
You must be brave to enter the Nether. Weren't you scared?
E-Excuse me, um, have you ever, um, seen a Zombified Piglin?
introverted.dialogue.story.nether.fail/1: I don't think you've really been to the Nether.
introverted.dialogue.story.nether.fail/2: Oh. I think I understand why those piglins attacked you.
introverted.dialogue.story.nether.fail/3: I don't mind whether you've been to the Nether, but... that wasn't much of a story.
introverted.dialogue.story.nether.fail/4: You don't look strong enough to survive the Nether. Sorry.
introverted.dialogue.story.nether.fail/5: My grandfather explored the Nether, but he never mentioned warped fungus. Are you sure?
introverted.dialogue.story.enderdragon.s: Did you... bring the dragon egg back with you?
You defeated the dragon? I can hardly believe it!
introverted.dialogue.story.enderdragon.f: The ender dragon? I thought it was only a story.
You faced the ender dragon? I don't see how anyone could defeat it!
introverted.dialogue.story.wither.succes: The Wither causes so much destruction. I can't imagine seeing one.
W-Wow! Y-You actually managed to defeat the Wither? That's absolutely amazing!
introverted.dialogue.story.wither.fail/1: Um, I'm not really convinced by what you're saying.
introverted.dialogue.story.wither.fail/2: Oh, you... you seem so intact for that to actually be true.
introverted.dialogue.stay.fail/1: Oh, um, no, thank you. I-I'm not really into staying in one place, you know?
introverted.dialogue.stay.fail/2: Oh, th-thank you for asking, but I-I'm more comfortable exploring, if that's okay...
introverted.dialogue.stay.fail/3: Um, well, this village seems lovely, but I-I'm more of a wanderer, you see...
introverted.dialogue.stay.repeat/1: Oh, um, sorry, but you've asked me this question before.
introverted.dialogue.stay.repeat/2: Um, sorry, but I think you've already asked me that.
introverted.dialogue.stay.success/1: Oh, um, thank you... I-I would really, um, enjoy staying in this village.
introverted.dialogue.stay.success/2: Oh wow, um, I... I'd absolutely love to stay in this village! It's amazing!
introverted.dialogue.stay.no_space/1: Um, gosh, this village is, uh, quite packed, isn't it?
introverted.dialogue.stay.no_space/2: Oh, um, I-I kind of wanted to stay, but, er, it seems there's no room for me. You know, all the beds are taken...
introverted.dialogue.hire/1: If you need help, I'll be here. Just let me know when, and we can sort out payment.
introverted.dialogue.hire/2: I'll be glad to help, if you've got the emeralds ready.
introverted.dialogue.hire/3: I can help when you need me. Just let me know, and have the emeralds ready.
introverted.dialogue.no_money/1: Sorry, I don't think you have enough emeralds to hire me.
introverted.dialogue.no_money/2: I could help, but you need a few more emeralds first.
introverted.dialogue.no_money/3: I... think you need more emeralds for my help. Sorry.
introverted.dialogue.main.rock_paper_sci: Um... would you like to play rock, paper, scissors?
introverted.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor/: U-Um, um... Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!
I-I really hope I can win this time...
Oh... um, I picked paper! So, uh, I guess I won...
Oh, um, I think I'll choose rock this time, if that's okay with you.
My rock beat your scissors. I... won!
Oh, um, it seems like rock, uh, defeats scissors... I-I lost.
I'm always outmatched when I pick rock, it's like a curse.
Your scissors beat my paper. Well done.
